CTS Corporation (NYSE: CTS) announced that its Board of Directors has promoted Pratik Trivedi, currently the company's chief operating officer, to chief executive officer and president, effective July 6, 2026. CTS Corporation Names COO Pratik Trivedi CEO and President · RPC, Inc. CEO Ben Palmer to retire by end of 2026 Robert Profusek, CTS' lead independent director, said in a statement that the appointment followed a two-year succession planning process. "As COO of CTS, Pratik's track record of strong execution, strategic leadership, and sustained results made him the unanimous choice to lead CTS going forward," Profusek said. Trivedi holds a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering from L.D. College of Engineering in India, a master's degree in industrial engineering from Texas A&M University, and an MBA from the University of Minnesota. His prior experience includes roles at Eaton and Cummins, in addition to CTS.
